notes.title: Project Status Update: The Count of Monte Cristo
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]
After careful consideration, I’ve decided to close active development on [i]The Count of Monte Cristo[/i].
This demo represents a fully playable concept, a standalone slice of what could have been. As a solo developer, I’ve chosen to focus my energy on a different project that’s now further along: a psychological horror game called [i]The Last Transmission[/i].[/p][p]I’m proud of what was built, and grateful to everyone who supported the project. Though the full version of this game won’t be developed, the demo remains available as a finished glimpse into the world I wanted to explore.[/p][p]Thanks again for playing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345465/634abf3299cac601edd8a7e07bf63285c7a87296.jpg"][/img][/p]
